findings.evidenceJa: 得られる物などないだろう。
findings.governingReading: He assumes there is probably nothing to gain by coming here.
findings.explanation: The English turns reflective expectation into fact and narrows “gain” to finding an object or clue.

findings.highlight: I ignore him and keep walking.
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二を無視してその横を通り抜ける。
findings.governingReading: Shirou ignores Shinji and passes directly beside him.
findings.explanation: The close physical passage that makes Shinji block him disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 地味なコトしてるから
findings.governingReading: because Shirou is doing such dull, unglamorous work
findings.explanation: Shinji mocks the work as petty and unflashy; “meddlesome” instead condemns interference.

findings.evidenceJa: にやついた声。
findings.governingReading: A voice audibly wearing a smirk.
findings.explanation: Delight loses the needling, self-satisfied expression encoded in にやつく.

findings.evidenceJa: 呪刻潰し
findings.governingReading: destroying the curse marks
findings.explanation: A discrete established term and the act of crushing its anchors collapse into generic “spell.”

findings.evidenceJa: 身構えながら慎二を睨む。
findings.governingReading: Shirou glares while maintaining a defensive fighting stance.
findings.explanation: The English omits that he remains physically ready for attack.

findings.highlight: this is how stupid I am.
findings.evidenceJa: これが俺の甘さだ。
findings.governingReading: This is Shirou’s softness or naïveté.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a recurring ethical and interpersonal weakness with low intelligence.

findings.evidenceJa: ヤツがそうなのだと判っていながら
findings.governingReading: Although Shirou knew Shinji was the one—a Master—
findings.explanation: The object of Shirou’s suppressed recognition disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: マスターに選ばれただけの人間だ。
findings.governingReading: He claims to be merely a person selected as Master.
findings.explanation: “Normal” omits the selection relation and supplies a broader claim of ordinariness.

findings.evidenceJa: 行き着く所までいくしかなくなる
findings.governingReading: he will be forced to carry the conflict through to its ultimate endpoint
findings.explanation: “Fight back” loses Shinji’s threat of uncontrolled escalation if attacked.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺にとっても願ってもない事だ。
findings.governingReading: For Shirou too, Shinji sincerely wanting no fight would be more than he could ask for.
findings.explanation: A bounded desired condition becomes the global claim that everything would work out.

findings.evidenceJa: 血が絶えていたから
findings.governingReading: because the magical bloodline had died out
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inference about lineage is collapsed into magic itself ceasing.

findings.evidenceJa: 部外者として除外していたのか。
findings.governingReading: perhaps Rin excluded the Matou as outsiders
findings.explanation: The English narrows a family/category inference to Shinji alone and omits outsider status.

findings.highlight: We can survive through the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に頼らなくても
findings.governingReading: without having to rely on Tohsaka
findings.explanation: The core competitive appeal of Shinji’s alliance proposal disappears.

findings.highlight: A slow woman like her wouldn’t be able to use magic.
findings.evidenceJa: あんなトロい女に魔道を伝えるもんか。
findings.governingReading: Shinji says he would never pass the magical path to a dull or slow woman like Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes his refusal and gatekeeping into an unsupported claim about Sakura’s ability.

findings.highlight: I want her to be smiling happily all the time.
findings.evidenceJa: 幸せそうに笑っていてくれなきゃ、いやだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot bear it unless Sakura continues smiling happily for him.
findings.explanation: Preference replaces the emotionally dependent, almost childlike insistence of くれなきゃ、いやだ.

findings.highlight: people that’ll bring disaster to this town.
findings.evidenceJa: 街に火を付けようとするヤツ
findings.governingReading: someone who tries to set the town on fire
findings.explanation: The English removes deliberate destructive agency and breaks the linked fire imagery.

findings.highlight: a house with a guy who’s going to fight.
findings.evidenceJa: これから殺し合いを続けるってヤツの家
findings.governingReading: the house of a man who will continue participating in mutual killing
findings.explanation: The English removes both lethal stakes and continuation from Shinji’s protective pretext.

findings.highlight: As long as I’ll be fighting
findings.evidenceJa: 俺がセイバーと一緒に戦う以上
findings.governingReading: as long as Shirou fights together with Saber
findings.explanation: Saber’s presence—the reason the Emiya house may attract danger—is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 後輩思いの先輩で助かった。
findings.governingReading: Shinji is relieved Shirou is an upperclassman considerate of his junior.
findings.explanation: The school relationship and pointed irony disappear.

findings.highlight: I was scared if you were going to hold her hostage.
findings.evidenceJa: いつ桜を人質にするか冷や冷やしてた
findings.governingReading: He claims he was anxiously wondering when Shirou might take Sakura hostage.
findings.explanation: “Scared if” is malformed and changes an insinuated expected timing into uncertainty over whether it would happen.

findings.highlight: I won’t stop her from fighting you
findings.evidenceJa: あいつがおまえの正体を知ったら、戦う事を止めない。
findings.governingReading: If Rin learns Shinji’s identity, she will not stop fighting.
findings.explanation: Rin’s independent resolve becomes Shirou’s decision not to restrain her.

findings.evidenceJa: 大人しくしてるんだな
findings.governingReading: Shinji should keep quiet and behave himself.
findings.explanation: The English makes the condition absolute inactivity rather than restrained conduct.
